title: Cortex Prime sheet template
description: A reusable sheet layout: same shape as a character entry ({ id (static), title, ..., character: {...} }). Trait sets carry stable ids joining character overrides to template layout. Imports dedupe by static id.

id.description: Static template identifier. Assigned once, never regenerated; imports replace the same id instead of duplicating.

character.description: Character-shaped blank carrying the layout (custom.cortexToolkit at sheet and set level) plus blank traits.
